title: Heyllamande
author: Jim Hemphill
problems: Row 1 "long lines forward & back and larks roll away the robins · roll-away" can't start from where the dancers are: A roll away needs the two side by side on one side.
Row 4 "swing through [Partner allemande right by half, robins allemande left half] · allemande" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0's right hand is not free.
Row 4 "swing through [Partner allemande right by half, robins allemande left half] · allemande" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 1 and 3 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 5 "balance the wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Everyone in the wave must be holding hands with their neighbors in line.
Row 6 "swing through [Neighbor allemande right by half, larks allemande left half] · allemande" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 2 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 5 "balance the wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Neighbors in a wave must face opposite ways.
The progression after row 8 "circle left 3 places" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 4 have not passed each other yet.
choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
